items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: He'd come back and raise cain with them for letting me sit in with Gee willigens. But I sat in with the band, I played one number with them, anyway.

ctx.x: In Kansas City. What's the name of that club? I don't know, Jo Jones used to do that, so he could get out -- say something to somebody, you know. He'd come back and raise cain with them for letting me sit in with Gee willigens. But I sat in with the band, I played one number with them, anyway.
